WITH ratio_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    PIC,
    HGB / HCT as ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
),
patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
    AVG(PIC) as avg_pic
  FROM ratio_data
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM ratio_data
),
qualified_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.avg_ratio,
    ps.avg_pic,
    (ps.avg_ratio - oar.overall_avg) as excess
  FROM patient_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_ratio oar
  WHERE ps.avg_ratio > oar.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pic) as mean_avg_pic,
  AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratios,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM qualified_patients;
